build: Lightning Sentry / Death Sentry Assassin (Trapsin; Maxroll Season 16 Lightning Sentry Assassin Endgame Build Guide), from the skill reset at 38
author: Teo1904 (Maxroll); the reset at 38 from the same author's Assassin Leveling guide

setup_legend.standard: The guide's Standard setup: 2x Cunning Greater Talons of Quickness (+3 Traps, 40% IAS; the guide socket-quests Rainbow Facets into them, this build keeps them unsocketed: natural-socket bases only), Griffon's Eye, Enigma (Mage Plate), Magefist, Arachnid Mesh, Mara's Kaleidoscope, 2x The Stone of Jordan, rare boots; the Act 2 Defensive (Holy Freeze) merc with Infinity (Thresher), Fortitude (Sacred Armor), Andariel's Visage.
setup_legend.starter: The guide's Starter setup = the leveling gear she resets with (Spirit sword, Ancients' Pledge, Lore, Stealth, Insight Partizan on the merc), Temper / Ground / Hearth helms and the Wand of Lower Resistance (and the Battle Staff of Teleportation until Enigma) on the swap.
setup_legend.alternative: Every other slot lists the guide's Gear Options (unique / set / runeword; rare, crafted and the other magic picks have no build-file form); the Magic Find setup's pieces (Heart of the Oak Flail, Spirit Monarch, Harlequin Crest, Skullder's Ire, Chance Guards, War Traveler, Nagelring) fold as alternatives with a note. Unique charms are in the charm wishlist.

stat_source: Maxroll Season 16 guide text (skills, setups, Gear Options, gameplay); item stats and required levels from blizzhackers/d2data (uniqueitems.json, setitems.json, runes.json + misc.json rune levels, magicprefix/suffix.json).

targets.skill_order: Reset at 38 (43 points): Lightning Sentry 15, Charged Bolt Sentry 10, Death Sentry 9, Burst of Speed 3, Cloak of Shadows 1, Mind Blast 1 and the prerequisites. Then 1 point each in Fade and Weapon Block, and max Lightning Sentry, Shock Web, Charged Bolt Sentry, Death Sentry, Fire Blast in that order (the Standard setup); the last point to Weapon Block, Wake of Fire or Shadow Master. 110 points at 99.
targets.traps: Lay 5 Lightning Sentries on one spot so they focus one target; once the first monsters die, 1-2 Death Sentries explode the corpses (fire + physical). Baal waves: 4 Lightning Sentries beside the spawn, 1 Death Sentry far enough away to keep its charges for corpse explosions.
targets.lightning_resistance: Patch 2.6: -x% enemy lightning resistance on gear applies to the traps: Griffon's Eye, Crescent Moon on the swap right after laying traps, the merc's Infinity (Conviction).
targets.immunes: Lower Resist from the Wand of Lower Resistance until Infinity; Crack of the Heavens sunders lightning immunity; Fire Blast for lightning and physical immunes; Death Sentry and the merc for the rest, or skip them.

merc.type: Act 2 Desert Mercenary, Defensive (Holy Freeze, hired in Nightmare): Insight Partizan to start, then Infinity (ethereal Thresher), Fortitude (Sacred Armor) and Andariel's Visage
merc.why: The merc deals with what is immune to the traps; Infinity's Conviction lowers resistances and breaks lightning immunity for the traps too (the guide: the Trapsin needs it to be fully functional).

act_tips.range: lvl 38-45 (Nightmare Act 4 on, after the reset)
tips: Reset at Akara at 38 before Act 4 Nightmare (the switch note's allocation).
5 Lightning Sentries on one spot, then 2-3 Death Sentries once the first monsters die; Cloak of Shadows / Mind Blast for crowd control; keep Burst of Speed up.
Lower Resist (the wand) on tanky and lightning-immune monsters until the first corpses; skip what Death Sentry can't kill (Teleport past the Maggot Lair and parts of Act 3).
Chaos Sanctuary: Grand Vizier of Chaos is always lightning immune; drag corpses onto immune seal bosses and blow them up, or reset the area.

The Ancients: drop 1-2 inventories of potions in the arena, recharge the wand, reset Ancients with Magic Resistant / Lightning Enchanted / Spectral Hit; kill Talic and Korlic first, fight Madawc around a pillar with Lower Resist.
From 45: two Cunning Greater Talons of Quickness (+3 Traps) from Anya in Nightmare / Hell, unsocketed (no socket quest).
Start runs with Battle Command twice and Battle Orders from Call to Arms, then the swap with the most +skills for Burst of Speed.
MIN-MAX: swap to Crescent Moon right after laying the Lightning Sentries and stay there until the traps are done.
Keep the merc close to the fight for Infinity's Conviction; Fire Blast on lightning and physical immunes; Fade instead of Burst of Speed to cap resistances.
